kinds.d: App that stores, generates and fills in passwords, passkeys and logins.
VPN client, with the service it connects to, that encrypts the owner's connection and routes it through a private network.
Program that encrypts whole drives, partitions, containers or single files so they open only with a key or password.
Program that recovers or removes forgotten passwords of files, archives, accounts or devices.
Program that overwrites storage so that the erased data cannot be recovered.

notes: Restraint-only. Password manager 34->11 (market brands, built-in Apple Passwords and Google Password Manager, KeePassXC for the open local-vault style); dropped Keychain (merged into Apple Passwords), Firefox Lockwise, Microsoft Autofill, discontinued and minor tools; plans became types; Norton range dropped. VPN 21->10. Encryption 70->8: kept built-in disk encryption, VeraCrypt, BestCrypt, Cryptomator, GnuPG and TrueCrypt as the icon of the kind; dropped enterprise/OEM endpoint products (Check Point, Sophos SafeGuard, McAfee, Symantec, Trend Micro, Seqrite, SECUDE, Bloombase, CryptoPro etc.), Knox and SecuBox per brief, OS-internal and command-line duplicates (Cryptoloop, GBDE, GELI, softraid, svnd, CGD, Loop-AES, eCryptfs, Tcplay) and dead tails; FileVault 2 merged into FileVault. Password recovery unchanged (2). Data eraser 15->9 (dropped srm, hdparm, HDDerase, dd, Parted Magic, ShredIt). No new kinds.
